title: Private Sandbar Adventure in Key West Backcountry
blurb:
*Visit Stockislandboatcharters.com for alternate availabilities and pricing.*
Embark on a tour through the beautiful Florida Keys mangrove back country. Stop at various sandbars to paddle board, snorkel, or just hang out. Watch for wildlife throughout the trip such as dolphins, sea turtles, fish, birds, and much more! A cooler filled with ice and bottled water will be provided. Feel free to bring any food or alcoholic beverages.
